title: Portsmouth Escape Room
specs: Multiple themed rooms with varying difficulty and success rates
Mobile escape games available for large groups and special events
Children 14 and younger must be accompanied by an adult
Everyone in the room must purchase a ticket regardless of age (except infants in carriers)
Groups of 1-4 pay $40 per person; groups 5+ pay $35 per person
Private rooms only; no strangers in the room
Special requests and private events outside normal hours priced at $350 per room (up to 10 participants)

blurb: Guests solve puzzles and find clues to complete a mission or escape the room within one hour. All games are private, suitable for families, friends, corporate team building, and special events. Multiple themed rooms with varying difficulty and group sizes are available on-site and mobile escape games off-site by request.
